title: Yeh challenge KOI nahi kar sakta (Season finale)
description: Season 2 Episode 20: You stay balanced only while your centre of mass is above your supporting foot — the wall stops you from shifting it.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 6 (centre of mass, balance/toppling)
hook_text: Yeh challenge koi nahi kar sakta. ABHI try karo 🧱
concept: You stay balanced only while your centre of mass is above your supporting foot — the wall stops you from shifting it.
on_screen_cues: stick figure against wall, CoM dot → "Balance: CoM must be above the support" → "Wall blocks the shift" → "Leaning Tower: tilted, but CoM inside base" → "NCERT XI Ch 6 · Season 3 next"
pinned_comment: Kar paaye? Sach bolna 😏 Aur ek aur: kursi pe baitho, peeth seedhi, haath use kiye bina khade ho jao — try karo.
suggested_titles: "Yeh challenge koi nahi kar sakta 🧱 (Physics proof)" / "Wall challenge — Centre of Mass explained"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [excited] Chintu, challenge!
Chintu: [cheerfully] Deewar ke paas khade ho. Right kandha, right hip, right pair... sab deewar se touch.
Gudiya: [confidently] Done. Easy.
Chintu: [mischievously] Ab left pair upar uthao.
Gudiya: [confused] Bas? Yeh toh... ruko... [gasps] main nahi utha sakti!
Chintu: [laughs] Koi nahi utha sakta! Screen wale, tum bhi try karo!
Gudiya: [surprised] Kyun?! Main gir kyun jaungi?!
Chintu: [excited] Tumhare body ka ek CENTRE hai. Centre of Mass. Tumhara pura weight wahi se lagta hai. Woh tumhare pet ke aas paas hai.
Gudiya: [curious] Toh?
Chintu: [cheerfully] Khade rehne ke liye woh centre tumhare pair ke UPAR hona chahiye. Left pair uthao, toh right pair pe aana padega.
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Aur uske liye mujhe right side jhukna padega...
Chintu: [elated] Aur wahan DEEWAR hai! Jhuk nahi sakti, centre shift nahi hoga, pair nahi uthega!
Gudiya: [elated] Matlab balance ka pura game bas ek point ko pair ke upar rakhna hai!
Chintu: [proudly] Isi liye Leaning Tower of Pisa 800 saal se khada hai. Tirchha hai, par centre abhi bhi base ke upar hai.
Gudiya: [laughs] Aur main deewar ke saath ek pair pe nahi khadi ho sakti.
Chintu: [cheerfully] Comment mein batao, kaun kar paaya. Spoiler: koi nahi.
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, Newton ki duniya samajh aa gayi. Ab?
Chintu: [dramatic tone] Ab ek jhooth todte hain jo tumne 10 saal se maana hai. Rubber... steel se ZYADA elastic nahi hai.
Gudiya: [gasps] Kya?!
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
